items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: Other guys, Art Blakey never said a word but he was very — he knew what he wanted from tune to tune. And there were tunes, like I said, that were specifically open, we could do whatever we wanted.

ctx.x: Yeah he was hands on in that department. Other guys, Art Blakey never said a word but he was very — he knew what he wanted from tune to tune. And there were tunes, like I said, that were specifically open, we could do whatever we wanted. And then he didn’t say anything.
What about you? Did you become, when you became a leader of a small group did you find yourself in that situation where you felt that’s not really what’s needed here?
